title: Will the cue still be there?
hook: A toy answer works only on tasks whose context cue matches the stored cue.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to identify the assumed cue dependence instead of treating the toy as a measured memory effect

misconception: Successful retrieval under one cue arrangement establishes the same retrieval after context changes.
objective: Identify the assumed cue dependence instead of treating the toy as a measured memory effect.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Each item has one cue; exact match succeeds with certainty; mismatch fails; context counts are invented; no decay or similarity grading. Familiar context retrieves {A}%; changed context {B}%. The matching share shrinks under an exact-match rule.
